description:
Behold Do Jin Woo, a devil with a lethal allure that blinds with a glance.   
Moami, an ordinary girl ensnared in his schemes through a slave contract.    
From schoolyard whispers to wedded bliss, their love tale spins sweet yet fierce.

**Original Novel:**    
Chapters: [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=2350379), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000096193)   
Volumes: [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=2350379), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000106303) 

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1020012845), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13854986), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68822908), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/Iloveyoudevil), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000076774)
